| `gates run` | Every form (B450): built-in, custom and formatter gates (pint and prettier check the supported Git files in argv batches), `repeat_new_tests` (changed sources add the tests that import them), light blocks, flaky detection and a run with no `--run` and no `--block`. A stop signal (SIGINT or SIGTERM) writes the same cancel rows. With `--run` and `--block` the B392 preflight runs first by default (`--no-preflight` skips it); a blocker stops `gates run` with exit 1 before any gate command runs. With no `HOME` the user's home folder is used, as Node does. A `--timeout-ms` over the 2147483647 ms timer limit runs with a 1 ms timer and prints Node's `TimeoutOverflowWarning`. A `--cwd` that is not a folder skips every gate, as Node does. An empty `--run` or `--block` prints Node's message with exit 1. A case Node also refuses is a one-line error with exit 1 or 2 that names the cause and the fix: a bad gate config (the same messages as config validation), a damaged run record, or `repeat_new_tests` on a block with no base commit. A command that cannot start is a red gate with reason `spawn-error`. Since B798 a red `go test` gate (program `go`: `go test`, or a `go -C <dir> run` wrapper that prints go test output) with `rerun_failed` on reruns only its failed top-level test names in one `go test -count=3 -run '^(A|B)$' <pkgs>` call (go test build flags such as `-race`, `-tags` and `-timeout` are kept); when all three pass the gate passes with `gates: WARN flaky test <name> (<pkgs>): failed, then passed 3/3 reruns (load <1-min load>)`, a `test.flaky` row `{test, packages, gate, load, reruns}` (signed in `block land`) and a `flaky-test` finding in `~/.code-forge/runs/<run>/findings.jsonl` (one per test, deduplicated by fingerprint); more than 3 failed names, a panic, a build or setup failure, or a failed package with no named test stays red with no rerun. | A gate command that is an executable file with no `#!` line (Node runs it with `/bin/sh` on Linux and stops with `spawn ENOEXEC` on macOS, B469; reason `gates-custom`); a run record whose `run_id` does not match `--run` (reason `gates-run-id-mismatch`), or with no `workspace` string (reason `gates-run-no-workspace`); also the `block land` gates step for these records. |
